evals.prompt: I'm a Python developer. Create a FastAPI backend named Veracity Reporting that lets users log in with Veracity. Default OIDC.
evals.expected_output: FastAPI BFF scaffolded under src/veracity-reporting-web/ with Authlib OIDC against Veracity B2C, signed-cookie session, /auth, /auth/challenge, /auth/callback, /api/me, /signout endpoints, pydantic-settings config, security headers, health checks.
assertions: FastAPI chosen as the framework
Baseline FastAPI project scaffolded via web-backend-python (health checks, security-headers/CSP, versioned /api/v1, ProblemDetails) before Veracity auth is layered on
Explicit project name Veracity Reporting normalized to Python project slug veracity-reporting
Project files created under src/veracity-reporting-web/ (OIDC = -web suffix)
pyproject.toml [project].name set to veracity-reporting-web
Import package remains app unless explicitly renamed
Strategy determined as OpenID Connect (BFF)
Authlib used for the OIDC login flow (authorize_redirect / authorize_access_token)
app/auth/oidc.py created with /auth, /auth/challenge, /auth/callback, /api/me, /signout

veracity_core/redirects.py created; the /auth/challenge returnUrl is passed through safe_return_url before it is stored in the session and before the /auth/callback redirect, so protocol-relative (//host) / absolute / backslash-obfuscated values collapse to / (CWE-601 open redirect)
Starlette SessionMiddleware configured with __Host- prefixed cookie when COOKIE_SECURE
Local development starts over HTTPS (for example via app/dev_server.py or uv run veracity-dev) with cert/key configuration
/api/me returns 401 (not a redirect) when unauthenticated
Production B2C authority used by default (login.veracity.com/dnvglb2cprod.onmicrosoft.com/B2C_1A_Identity/v2.0)
User guided to set CLIENT_SECRET in .env, not asked to paste it in chat
A strong SESSION_SECRET is generated into the local .env by the skill
settings.py session_secret has NO hard-coded default and is required/validated (>=32 chars) for OIDC; app fails fast if missing (CWE-259)
Local HTTPS cert and key files are generated automatically (via scripts/generate_dev_cert.py, invoked by the dev launcher or veracity-dev-cert) at the .env cert/key paths, with no manual mkcert step
User asked for the Client ID (GUID, non-secret)

evals.prompt: Build the FastAPI Veracity BFF that backs the React frontend generated by veracity-auth-ui, including the calls that list my Veracity services and applications.
evals.expected_output: FastAPI OIDC BFF whose routes match the veracity-auth-ui SPA exactly: /auth, /auth/challenge, /auth/callback (callback), /signout, /api/me, plus the Veracity API proxy at /api/v1/veracity/v3/services and /api/v1/veracity/v4/me/applications. REDIRECT_URI is set to the Vite proxy origin so B2C returns to the SPA origin.
assertions: Baseline FastAPI project scaffolded via web-backend-python (health, security headers, versioned /api/v1, ProblemDetails) before the Veracity BFF is layered on
OIDC callback route is /auth/callback (the Authlib default, forwarded by the SPA's /auth dev-proxy rule), not /signin-oidc
Sign-out route is lowercase /signout (FastAPI is case-sensitive), not /signOut
Veracity API proxy mounted at /api/v1/veracity/v3/services and /api/v1/veracity/v4/me/applications, matching the SPA's src/api/veracity.ts paths
Proxy routes call the Veracity Platform API as the signed-in user via MSAL on-behalf-of and attach the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key
Proxy routes return 401 when the session has no user or no stored access token so the SPA can silently re-challenge
The OIDC callback stores the user's access token in the session for the OBO exchange
REDIRECT_URI setting added and set to the Vite proxy origin (e.g. https://localhost:5173/auth/callback) so B2C returns to the SPA origin holding the session cookie
That exact REDIRECT_URI is noted as a reply URL to register on the Veracity app registration
No changes required to the veracity-auth-ui frontend to talk to this BFF
